mu_name_from: OURS, the user's of 2026-09-28: 'in our game we will have orb of skillshot, that is multishot skill for any elf bow or crossbow'. 0.75 has no such orb: Triple Shot (24) comes only on a bow carrying the Skill option.
why_this_one: The elf's first skill and her quick-slot auto-attack (sim/skills.cpp, Skillshot). Early and cheap, as the Orb of Summoning is: drop level 3, 150 zen, no requirement. Its number, 21, is free in 0.75's group 12 (wings 0-2, the elf's orbs 8-11, the Jewel of Chaos 15; every other free number already carries one of this project's knight orbs).
mesh_note: No geometry of its own. Gem01.bmd through Gem05.bmd are byte-identical in MuMain's Data/Item -- one md5 across all five -- so every orb in MU is one model told apart by its row, and this names the one the pipeline has built.

stats.note: Ours: the Orb of Summoning's shape (Version075/Items/Orbs.cs:36) with a free number.
stats.durability_note: One. One reading, as a scroll is.
stats.classes_from: CharacterClasses.FairyElf. Every skill in this orb's family is the elf's; a knight or a wizard cannot learn it at any level.
stats.requires_note: Carried raw, as every orb's is (docs/mu-scrolls-and-orbs.md SS4). The same numbers are on the skill block below, which is what Realm::useItem checks.

skill.note: What the orb teaches. Read once and gone.
skill.name: Skillshot
skill.tells: Three arrows loosed in a fan at a body up to nine tiles off, each flying on through everything in its way. One arrow is spent for every body struck.
skill.tells_from: The skill's own line in sim/skills.cpp, kept letter for letter so the orb's tooltip and the skill's card cannot say different things.
skill.energy_from: None: it is how a new elf's bow becomes her bar, and nothing about it wants energy.
skill.level_from: Ours: about twice the scroll's drop level, in MU's own order (the user's audit of 2026-10-02: 'currently chars can get end game scroll and orbs pretty fast, remember we have 100% exp rate'). At kExperienceRate 100 a character who never leaves Lorencia reaches level 60 in about a hundred kills and 120 in about sixteen hundred, so MU's own gates -- energy alone on a scroll, the drop level on an orb -- fell within minutes. The energy (or other stat) MU asks is kept beside it.
